summary: Main guide to editor Python: enabling the Python Editor Script Plugin, every way to run scripts (Python console, py command, File menu, -ExecutePythonScript, pythonscript commandlet, init_unreal.py, startup scripts, editor-only Blueprint nodes), sys.path setup, how the unreal module reflects Blueprint-exposed APIs, and best practices (set_editor_property, ScopedEditorTransaction, ScopedSlowTask, logging).
gotchas: Python runs only in the editor, never in PIE, Standalone or cooked builds, so it cannot be gameplay script
Do not use py in -ExecCmd at startup; script may run before the level is loaded
The pythonscript commandlet does not load levels; call load_level first, and load_level fails by default (UnsavedChangesPolicy Fail) if packages are unsaved
Never move/rename assets with os/shutil; use unreal.EditorAssetLibrary or AssetTools; PCGComponent Generate/GenerateLocal unavailable from Python (use ExecuteGraphInstance)
new_in_59: Blueprint classes and User Defined Structs now get their own generated Python wrapper types (e.g. BP_MyActor_C) instead of their native parent/StructBase; set Engine.Python.WrapBlueprintClassesOnDemand / WrapUserDefinedStructsOnDemand to false for the 5.8 behaviour.
